who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), allocs ratchet lane, int-1112
what: blaze_lints::baseline::read refuses every file of crates/blaze-lints/baselines that is not TARGET or `<tool>.<lint>.txt` of a known lint, so the `// alloc:` ratchet's list, kept beside the allocator lints' baselines, makes `blaze check --baselines crates/blaze-lints/baselines` fail with BaselineError::Lint until read skips it.
cost: a lane outside crates/blaze-lints/src could not land the list without breaking the lint-baselines job; a hand-off to the main agent
cause: the directory has one reader that assumes it holds only per-lint count files, and the names it may also hold (TARGET) are special-cased in that reader
class: a directory shared by several ratchets whose reader knows only one of them
prevention: name every file the directory may hold in one place (TARGET, the lint baselines by pattern, alloc-sites.txt), read by both baseline::read and the scripts
workaround: baseline::read skips `alloc-sites.txt` as it skips TARGET (a const beside TARGET_FILE)
